item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:35 HKT 13/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days, it will be generally cloudy over the region. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Saturday. Temperatures will fall appreciably with a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon, it will be cold in the morning over Guangdong early next week. A dry replenishment of the monsoon will bring generally fine weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week, it will be persistently cold over the region.
